# Nikunj Dhanani - Family & Life Counseling Practice

> Professional counseling practice dedicated to evidence-based family guidance, relationship repair, and 1-on-1 personal life coaching based in Surat, Gujarat, India, and accessible worldwide online.

## Practice Areas & Core Services

### 1. Parenting Coaching & Youth Guidance
- **Target Audience**: Parents dealing with child screen addiction, aggressive behavioral outbursts, academic exam stress, adolescent moodiness, or broken parent-child communication.
- **Methodology**: Non-punitive, emotionally attuned communication, family systems structuring, and positive behavioral reinforcement.
- **Format**: In-person at Surat clinic or online video consultations via Zoom / Google Meet.
- **Duration**: 60 minutes per session.
- **URL**: https://www.nikunjdhanani.com/services/parenting-coaching

### 2. Relationship Repair & Couples Counseling
- **Target Audience**: Married couples, partners, or pre-marital couples facing chronic cyclical arguments, emotional disconnection, trust erosion, or family boundary friction.
- **Methodology**: Imago-inspired dialogue, de-escalation strategies, active empathetic listening, and trust restoration protocols.
- **Format**: In-person in Surat or joint online video sessions.
- **Duration**: 60 to 75 minutes per session.
- **URL**: https://www.nikunjdhanani.com/services/relationship-repair

### 3. 1-on-1 Personal Counseling & Life Coaching
- **Target Audience**: Adults, working professionals, and executives dealing with anxiety, chronic stress, career burnout, identity crises, or decision fatigue.
- **Methodology**: Cognitive-behavioral coping frameworks, mindfulness-based emotional regulation, and structured action planning.
- **Format**: In-person in Surat or confidential online video sessions.
- **Duration**: 60 minutes per session.
- **URL**: https://www.nikunjdhanani.com/services/counselling-life-coaching

## Geographical Service Coverage
- **In-Person Physical Clinic**: Mota Varachha, Surat, Gujarat, India.
- **Regional Service Areas**: Surat, Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Rajkot, Mumbai, and across Gujarat & Maharashtra.
- **Pan-India Online Care**: Delhi NCR, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Kolkata, Chennai, and tier 1/2 Indian cities.
- **Global NRI Community**: Online counseling via Zoom for Indian families in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Singapore, and Australia.

## Ethics, Privacy & Confidentiality
- All counseling sessions are 100% confidential.
- Personal identifying details, clinical notes, and session summaries are never disclosed to third parties without prior written authorization.
- Note: This counseling practice offers structured wellness and life guidance by appointment. For immediate medical emergencies or severe crises, individuals must contact national 24/7 crisis helplines (India Tele-MANAS: 14416 | Vandrevala Foundation: +91 9999 666 555).
